scope: Root inspection of selected SHMEM files copied read-only from the task installation/source tree; no new device test or hardware memory-model proof

findings.finding: qp_quiet reads the selected SQ state and calls poll_cq with state->cqe_cnt. It does not append a fresh signaled ordering operation. poll_cq returns immediately for idx0 or an already-retired target; otherwise it checks owner/status/substatus and updates CQ/SQ tails. Unsignaled RO data therefore still needs the existing explicit SO completion boundary before quiet can cover it.

CQE entry_idx is unwrapped as a16-bit next-WQE basic-block counter relative to the previous SQ tail. It is neither a row index nor a logical final-write sequence. New tile protocol must retain an explicit checkpoint-to-logical-write-prefix mapping, including control WQEs and any multi-descriptor logical writes.

compute_slot is compile-time gated: direct returns pe; relay returns pe*rank_count+relay. QP-specific quiet rejects the relay-supported branch. Source branch definitions alone do not prove the actual binary's selected compile-time branch; maintain build/config binding and actual state-alias evidence.

Ordering configuration explicitly distinguishes NO, RO and SO; SO uses0b110. Declaring that field selects a WQE ordering mode but does not by itself provide an independent proof of receiver cache visibility or a new mixed-kernel acquire protocol.

The selected SIMT put helper translates to peer heap and assigns elements in a threadgroup-strided loop. put128 is instantiated with int4 in source_simt_rma.hpp. A count of2 is two128-bit elements; this source does not promise atomic32-byte descriptor visibility. Existing target-platform assumptions remain separate from a future explicit seal/epoch commit protocol.

implications: Preserve SO/checkpoint/quiet and helper-owned CQ snapshot lifetimes. Do not delete completion operations merely because a new ready flag is present.
Use immutable per-checkpoint source payload until true transport retirement; a changing scalar backing several asynchronous notifications can expose a later value too early.
Treat logical write sequence, SQ BB head/tail, CQ ordinal/ticket and descriptor epoch as distinct values with explicit associations.

Actual native domain identity includes issuing rank/context and the real ordered SQ state alias, not just logical peer/QP. Clos mailbox gives only scoped equality classes; FM and cross-owner/lane relations remain unresolved.
The historical1431 failure is not attributed to any of these source-level hazards. No new failure has been reproduced or causally explained by this review.
provenance_limits: Root reviewed final shmem_installed_header_evidence_20261026.json (SHA ccb66af30f4c5a35eff2ce7da9723b4711dd55c71166246859a7798fb2e719e0). Eight header copies match recorded build-info hashes; six private installed/src files were separately read and match repository source copies.

Existing flags name installed/src. Existing dispatch.o.d does not enumerate these private headers, so the selected preprocessed relay/template branch is not proven. Current disk SO hashes match the historical0526 initial/final mapped FD hashes, but this collection is not a new live-process observation.
No runtime CQ/SQ state, trace, memory-order litmus or new NPU result was produced. This narrows the implementation contract; it does not qualify a fused pipeline or performance.

immediate_signal_candidate.finding: The installed-source selected-QP put_signal_nbi builds WRITE_WITH_NOTIFY with params.signal stored directly in the WQE notify payload (including wrapped multi-BB path), rather than reading the signal value later from a changing GM scalar. This is a concrete alternative to per-notification GM signal-value slots for a future frontier design.
constraints: This operation consumes2 WQE basic blocks and the standalone scalar/MTE3 APIs require CONFIG.cqe!=0. It cannot be inserted as an assumed one-BB/unsignaled operation into the existing two-outstanding-CQ/helper-ACK pipeline.
The selected-QP API rejects ACLSHMEM_RELAY_SUPPORTED. Valid runtime QP count, actual queue-state alias and actual compiled branch still need binding.
The data SGE still reads a source address and requires its original lifetime through completion. Immediate notification does not free the attached data source.

A signal value embedded in the WQE does not prove receiver visibility/order/atomic acquire or previous-RO coverage; a reviewed SO configuration, epoch/sequence encoding, payload and flag visibility diagnostic are still required. No zero-byte special case or unsupported mode is assumed.
